author: TEDx Talks
description:
This TEDx talk challenges the supermom myth and the unrealistic expectations placed on women in motherhood. It reveals the hidden costs of juggling the endless mental load, emotional labor, and invisible work that leave so many mothers burned out, anxious, and disconnected from themselves. Through powerful storytelling and research, it introduces a three-part antidote to Supermom Syndrome. Moms will walk away inspired to hang up the cape, reclaim their identity, and embrace self-care without guilt, while families, partners, and communities will discover why supporting mothers benefits everyone. 

Onnie Michalsky is a licensed therapist, consultant, and host of the Moms Without Capes Podcast. She’s passionate about helping women who feel lost under the weight of motherhood shed the do-it-all mindset, break through self-limiting beliefs, and make room for self-care and growth. As an advocate for mental health, Onnie has also joined forces with Upstream Strategy Partners to make mental h
title: Why moms shouldn't have to do it all | Onnie Michalsky | TEDxBillings

author: TEDx Talks
description: Seeing her own name for local school board on the same ballot as candidates for president crystallized something Nadia Poluhina had only recently begun to understand: democracy happens much closer to home, and public service is not reserved for “other people.” It is a place where capable people can bring the skills and judgment they already have. Drawing on experience in finance, systems, and complex institutions, Nadia explores what happens when capable people assume public leadership belongs to someone else. When a school-district budget crisis made the stakes of local decision-making impossible to ignore, she realized that professional expertise could also become a form of civic stewardship. In this personal and humorous talk, Nadia argues that leadership is not about waiting until we feel completely ready. It is about recognizing what we can contribute, stepping into rooms where decisions are made, and accepting responsibility when our judgment is needed. Democracy is stronger whe
title: Where Democracy Lives: Leadership Before Confidence | Nadia Poluhina | TEDxMinneapolis

author: TEDx Talks
description: How often do you turn to AI when you have a question? And when the result disappoints you, what went wrong? There are times when involving AI is absolutely smart, but there are also times when it is even smarter to use human intelligence first. Michael is talking about what soft skills are required in the wavy times of AI and how his passion for surfing taught him enjoy the process. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Soft skills in the age of AI | Michael Streit | TEDxInnsbruck

description: When was the last time you said yes to a commitment? And did your actions match your words? Saying yes is easy - acting on it is a choice. If you reflect honestly on that difference, your next yes will mean more. He is a student of the Technical University of Munich as well as Co-Founder, and Head of HR & Administration at Munich Music Labs. He will be talking about Honest Commitments. description: What is the difference between art and neuroscience? For Verena, it is not the perspective you bring but the questions you are willing to ask, and the experiments that follow. That is creative problem solving, and the two fields have more in common than you might think. She is working as ob her PhD as Neuro- & Cancer Scientist at the University of Cambridge and tells us her insights about Creative Problem Solving. author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Syafiq shares his personal journey of overcoming academic setbacks and repeated rejections, highlighting how finding a pathway aligned with his passion for sports transformed his life. 

Despite initially struggling academically and facing multiple rejections from polytechnic, he persevered and went on to pursue a degree, a Master's and a doctoral programme in sports and exercise science. 

Drawing parallels with his experience as a marathon runner, he emphasises the importance of resilience, consistency and making small, incremental improvements. 

He also highlights the importance of leading by example in his role as a healthcare professional and advocating for healthier living. He is a firm believer of encouraging students to recognise that their starting point does not determine their destination, and that zero represents a fresh start and an opportunity for growth...not failure. Syafiq Faruq is an ITE alumnus and allied health professional who graduated with a Highe
title: The Power of Zero - Life is a Marathon, Not a Sprint | Syafiq Faruq | TEDxITECCYouth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Watch and hear Shane Chiang as he shares his personal journey of overcoming academic struggles, financial hardships and career setbacks to illustrate the Power of Zero; the ability to start afresh and turn challenges into opportunities. 

From repeating Primary 2 and taking on menial jobs to becoming a Chief Marketing Officer at Nokia and subsequently founding his own cybersecurity company, he demonstrates that one's beginnings do not determine one's future. He emphasises the importance of perseverance, continuous learning and having the courage to embrace new beginnings. 

Through his experiences, he encourages us to view failures as opportunities for growth rather than reasons to give up. The message is simple; yet profound: No matter how many times you start from zero...you always have the power to rewrite your story. Shane Chiang is the Founder and CEO of Momentum Z, a cybersecurity, AI governance and digital trust consultancy advising organisations across Asia.

Currently pursuin
title: The Power of Zero - From Janitor to CEO  | Shane Chiang | TEDxITECCYouth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
ITE student Athan Leroy Lim shares his experience representing ITE at the ITE-VTC International Student Seminar 2026, reflecting on the uncertainties and challenges of stepping into an unfamiliar environment. 

Through interactions with students from Hong Kong and Shenzhen, he discovered the value of cross-cultural connections, collaboration and embracing different perspectives. His involvement in the seminar's social media team also allowed him to explore his creativity, develop confidence and discover new strengths. 

Discussions on sustainability further broadened his understanding of how young people can take initiative and contribute towards shaping the future. 

He feels very strongly about getting fellow students to overcome their fears, seize opportunities and recognise that growth begins when we have the courage to take the first step into the unknown. Athan is a student from ITE College Central who participated in the International Student Seminar (ISS) 2026, where he gained
title: The Power of Zero - Starting from Zero in a Changing World  | Athan Leroy Lim | TEDxITECCYouth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Stardust is falling around us all the time. On rooftops, windowsills and city streets. Jon Larsen tells how an obsessive curiosity about tiny particles led from jazz clubs to microscopes, scientific verification and a new way of finding micrometeorites in urban environments. His story is not only about cosmic dust. It is about attention: how a willingness to look closely at the ordinary can open an unexpected path to discovery, and how science can begin with a simple question that nobody thought worth asking. Jon Larsen is a Norwegian jazz musician, composer, visual artist and citizen scientist. After decades in music, including as a founding figure in Hot Club de Norvège, his curiosity shifted toward tiny particles hidden in everyday dust. Through the Stardust Project he developed methods for distinguishing micrometeorites from human-made particles, contributing to research that helped change how scientists think about collecting modern cosmic dust in populated areas. His journey is
title: In Search of Stardust | Jon Larsen | TEDxFredrikstad

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the most important thing you bring to a room isn't your talent, expertise, or experience?

After decades as a drummer, songwriter, and music producer, Jeremy Lutito discovered that mastering his craft was only part of what made him valuable. The greater challenge was learning how to influence a creative process without controlling it.

In this TEDxNashville talk, he explores how a quality he once considered a weakness became one of his greatest strengths as a creative leader. 

This talk was presented at TEDxNashville, an independently organized TED event. Jeremy Lutito is a Grammy-nominated producer, songwriter, composer, and multi-instrumentalist based here in Nashville. Known for his versatility and dynamic sound, he has collaborated with artists like Judah & the Lion, Michigander, Little Image, Joy Oladokun, Devon Gilfillian, and more. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https:/
title: Your skill might be ruining your ability to lead | Jeremy Lutito | TEDxNashville Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Where do great ideas come from? And what if the idea you're looking for is already hidden in your everyday experiences?

In this engaging talk, JD Ghai takes us through the unexpected journey behind his venture, one of India's early digital entertainment platforms. What began with a love for humour, an ordinary conversation at a party and a curiosity about the emerging internet eventually became a business that reached millions of people.

Drawing from his 27 years in the digital space, JD Ghai shares how he moved beyond his family's real estate business, took a chance on an unfamiliar industry and built a venture through perseverance, experimentation and an ability to understand changing audience interests.

His message is simple: ideas are all around us. Sometimes, we just need to look at our experiences differently to recognise them. Jiwandeep Singh Ghai (JD Ghai) is a pioneering entrepreneur, digital media leader, and the Founder & CEO of SantaBanta.com, one of India's earliest an
title: What If the Idea You Seek Is Already Around You? | Jiwandeep Singh Ghai (JD Ghai) | TEDxSukhna Lake

author: TEDx Talks
description: Costa Rica tuvo pocos pobladores y un antecedente genético muy corto, y por eso es potencia mundial en enfermedades raras. Esta charla explica cómo el estudio de más de 2.400 familias revela que el gen BRCA2 es 8 veces más frecuente aquí que BRCA1. Un llamado a conocer nuestros antecedentes familiares y a tratarnos con empatía y tolerancia. Carlos Santamaría Quesada. Microbiólogo. Máster en Inmunología Clínica UCR. Doctor en Ciencias Médicas (Ph.D.) por la Universidad de Salamanca, España. Premio Nacional de Ciencia “Clodomiro Picado Twight” 2011 por investigación en marcadores moleculares en leucemia. Premio “Doctor Moraza” a la mejor tesis de investigación en Oncología 2011 en Salamanca, España. Jefe del laboratorio de Diagnóstico Molecular, Hospital Nacional de Niños. Docente pregrado y posgrado UCR. Autor de 38 artículos científicos internacionales, conferencista. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community.
title: ¡Todos somos primos! | Carlos Santamaría | TEDxPuraVidaSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
En la era victoriana se vendía aceite de serpiente; hoy se venden dietas milagro y consejos de falsos expertos en redes sociales, algunos creados con inteligencia artificial. La charla explica por qué somos tan vulnerables a estos mensajes cuando se trata de salud y ofrece cuatro consejos para que los profesionales de la salud recuperen la conversación. Gabriela Murillo Solís es nutricionista graduada con honores de la Universidad de Costa Rica.
Obtuvo su maestría y doctorado en Ciencias de la Nutrición con énfasis en Nutrición Molecular en la Universidad de Connecticut (UConn) gracias a una beca Fulbright.
Actualmente es profesora de bioquímica y subdirectora de la Oficina de Asuntos Internacionales
en la UCR y profesora de Nutrición en Texas Tech Costa Rica.
 
Uno de sus pilares de trabajo es la democratización de la ciencia, lo cual hace a través de trabajos comunales universitarios, charlas, foros, colaboraciones en medios de comunicación, así como contenido propio en sus redes so
title: Aceite de serpiente | Gabriela Murillo | TEDxPuraVidaSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description: ¿A quién pertenece el conocimiento cuando la inteligencia artificial responde por nosotros? Con la metáfora de un muro de ladrillos, la charla advierte sobre la descarga cognitiva y propone usar la IA en medicina para ampliar el conocimiento, no para reemplazarlo, sin perder nunca la responsabilidad frente al paciente. Mauricio Guadamuz es médico graduado de UCIMED, MBA por IPADE Business School, Máster en Mercadeo y Ventas por la Universidad de Costa Rica y Máster en Ingeniería de Dispositivos Médicos por el Tecnológico de Costa Rica. En más de treinta años, su trayectoria lo ha llevado del consultorio y los hospitales a la industria farmacéutica, la Dirección Médica de compañías globales y la consultoría estratégica. Hoy trabaja en una firma global de consultoría en salud digital, transformación, estrategia e inteligencia artificial, entre otras áreas. Su recorrido entre medicina, negocios y tecnología alimenta las preguntas que hoy lo ocupan: cómo cambia el conocimiento médico, cóm
title: ¿Quién está haciendo el pensamiento? | Mauricio Guadamuz | TEDxPuraVidaSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
La medicina moderna cura de forma extraordinaria, pero la prevención es mucho más difícil de predecir. Esta charla muestra que los hábitos más poderosos, como moverse, respirar, descansar y conectar con otros, coinciden con rituales y tradiciones de culturas muy distintas que la ciencia apenas ahora confirma. Mauricio Obón es cardiólogo intervencionista y Director de Cardiología del Hospital Metropolitano de Costa Rica, el programa de cardiología de mayor volumen del país.
Estudió medicina en la UCIMED en Costa Rica, se especializó en Medicina Interna en la Universidad Estatal de Nueva York (SUNY Upstate), y completó su formación en Cardiología y Cardiología Intervencionista en el Texas Heart Institute del Baylor College of Medicine en Houston, Texas — uno de los centros de referencia mundial en cardiología y el lugar donde siempre soñó formarse. Allí también realizó investigación clínica en válvulas percutáneas y patología estructural cardíaca, un campo en el que lleva cientos de pro
title: El pasado ya era evidencia | Mauricio Obón | TEDxPuraVidaSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Desde una pizarra colgada bajo un roble en 1933 hasta las islas del Golfo de Nicoya, esta charla cuenta cómo aprender a estar presente transforma la consulta médica. Habla de compasión, de vulnerabilidad y de por qué la empatía puede ser una fórmula contra el agotamiento, más allá de los minutos que dure el encuentro. Ricardo Millán es psiquiatra, investigador, escritor y fotógrafo. Es profesor catedrático de la Universidad de Costa Rica y miembro correspondiente de la Academia Nacional de Medicina de Costa Rica.

Ha desarrollado su carrera en torno a los aspectos psiquiátricos de la enfermedad física (área conocida como Psiquiatría de Interconsulta y Enlace) y a cómo los desbalances fisiológicos determinan los síntomas emocionales y cognitivos (lo que de conoce como Psiquiatría Integrativa).

Es autor de múltiples publicaciones en revistas científicas indexadas, así como de numerosos artículos de narrativa y opinión en la prensa escrita nacional e internacional, en donde destaca sus
title: Momentos de consultorio | Ricardo Millán | TEDxPuraVidaSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
A través de un álbum de fotos familiar, esta charla recorre las etapas de una vida y muestra cómo las vacunas protegen en cada una, desde la infancia hasta la vejez. El mensaje: la vacunación no es solo para los niños, es para todas las etapas de la vida. Neumóloga pediatra costarricense con más de 25 años de trayectoria en atención clínica, educación médica, investigación y liderazgo en salud. Dirigió el Departamento de Medicina del Hospital Nacional de Niños entre 2014 y 2026 y el Departamento de Pediatría de la Asociación Latinoamericana del Tórax entre 2022 y 2026. Actualmente labora en la Subárea Administrativa de Campos Clínicos, Internado y Posgrado del CENDEISSS–CCSS. Es docente de la Universidad de Costa Rica e investigadora en asma e infecciones respiratorias, en colaboración con las universidades de Harvard y Pittsburgh.

Participación en las recomendaciones latinoamericanas sobre vacunas en pacientes con enfermedades respiratorias. This talk was given at a TEDx event using
title: Álbum de fotografías | Lydiana Ávila | TEDxPuraVidaSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description: What do you do when the pressure feels like too much? Looking back at his younger self, Alessandro feels grateful for everything he has already achieved, yet he knows his own thoughts are the only thing standing between him and the gold medal. So over the years, he has learned that the hardest skill of all is mastering your own thoughts. As a Double Olympic Champion of the Austrian Olympic Team he is talking about Mental Pressure & Self Talk. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: When Hard Work Isn't Enough | Alessandro Hämmerle | TEDxInnsbruck

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if we’ve been trying to build the “we” before we’ve fully understood the “me”?

We often think of community as something we find in other people, places, and shared experiences. But what if the most important community we will ever belong to is the one we build within ourselves?

In this thought-provoking talk, Antoinette Summer invites us to reconsider community through a different lens: the community of one. She challenges us to examine the boundaries we establish, the access we grant, and the relationships we maintain before extending ourselves to the world around us.

Because before we open ourselves to connection, we must understand what deserves access. And boundaries aren’t walls designed to keep everyone out; they’re filters that help us recognize what belongs.

Through a fresh perspective on belonging, self-awareness, and personal boundaries, Antoinette explores the possibility that building meaningful connections with others begins with understanding our relationship wi
title: Community of One: The Front Porch Edition | Antoinette Summer | TEDxTinley Park

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if your greatest talent could do more than bring you personal success? Every individual has unique abilities, but their true value lies in how we use them to inspire, empower, and make a difference in the lives of others. Because sometimes, the greatest impact begins when we choose to share what we have. An Islamic Education (PAI) teacher at Cahaya Rancamaya IBS, Bogor. He has been skilled in graphic design since college. He also manages a community of high school and university students, and teaches a graphic design class for college students from various regions of Indonesia. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description: Dr E S Krishnamoorthy dwelled into what dimensions are critical to help a human flourish  **Dr. Ennapadam S. Krishnamoorthy** is a distinguished Behavioural Neurologist and Neuropsychiatrist, trained at the Institute of Neurology, University College London, under Professor Michael Trimble. A Fellow of the Royal Colleges of Physicians of London, Glasgow and Edinburgh, his academic work spans epilepsy, dementia and neuropsychiatric disorders. He has contributed to international clinical guidelines and co-edited global reference texts on dementia and epilepsy for Cambridge University Press. He is the Founder and Chairman of Buddhi Clinic, India's first integrated neuropsychiatry and advanced neurorehabilitation network, and mentors clinicians and researchers at the intersection of neurology and psychiatry. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
